mission.question: Facing the station, then turned away and driven to the far end of the tank, then turned back and driven to the stand-off: does the forward camera lose tag 146 and find it again, and what do the EKF and the ground truth show over the loss?

context.purpose: pipeline-correctness run for the lab's tag-aided localization test (piccard-inc/race_auv discussion #12, Tony's comment of 2026-10-14): one run, forward camera, tag 146, EKF odometry as BetweenFactors and the tag position as a landmark; no metrics or pass criteria

gain_sources.flight: upstream race_auv da58963 config_sim.yaml flight mode, unchanged
gain_sources.docking.x/y: M2 selection p10 (p 10, i 0.2, d 0, v 5, +/-15), as the M3 examples

context.apriltag_tag_size: black_square_edge, set explicitly: a pose mission defaults to lab_configured, whose detections read 1.25 x long (runtime/mission.py: the lab's configured size is the 0.15 m texture box, the black square 0.8 of it; #265 D0)
context.pose_derivation: stand-off: cg_link at Stonefish world (1.0, 0.325, 3.78) heading north, controller (-0.325, 4.8), the forward camera 2.3-2.4 m from the tags; the far pose is controller y 0.8 facing south, which puts the nose (0.7 m ahead of cg_link) 0.87 m from the south wall at controller y -0.77; all moves are along the tank axis, so transits are surge, not sway
context.speed: the lab's gains unchanged; in the 2026-10-14 drift-and-revisit run the vehicle reached 0.21-0.22 m/s surge on 3.9 m transits with thrusters at 0.55 of their limit, so the 4.0-4.8 m transits here run in the 0.1-0.3 m/s surge range the lab asked for and settle at the pose
context.visibility: tools/analysis/race_tag_visibility.py on this mission: tag 146 detectable by the forward camera at dive (7.1 m), approach, view, back and hold (2.3 m) and turn_back (6.9 m); no tag in either camera's widened field of view at turn_away and out; about 150 s of 640 s with the tags out of view
context.timing: dive 40 s, approach 120 s, view 60 s, turn away 30 s, out 120 s, turn back 30 s, back 120 s, hold 120 s: 640 s of dwell inside a 1200 s horizon
